description: This file implements a client for integrating HeyGen's real-time avatar API within the Pipecat framework. It manages WebSocket and LiveKit connections for avatar control, audio/video streaming, and participant event handling, supporting both interactive and live avatar services.

classes.name: ServiceType
classes.description: Enumeration for HeyGen service types: INTERACTIVE_AVATAR and LIVE_AVATAR.

classes.name: HeyGenCallbacks
classes.description: Data model for callback handlers triggered on participant connect/disconnect events.

classes.name: HeyGenClient
classes.description: Main class managing interactions with HeyGen's real-time avatar API, including session management, WebSocket and LiveKit connections, and participant event handling.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Creates a new HeyGen session and logs session details.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the client, establishing a new session and callback handling.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closing sessions and cancelling tasks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts WebSocket and LiveKit connections, initializing audio/video streaming.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all connections and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _ws_connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to HeyGen.

methods.name: _ws_receive_task_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: _handle_ws_server_event
methods.description: Processes WebSocket events from HeyGen.

methods.name: _ws_disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _ws_send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupts current avatar action, returning to idle.

methods.name: start_agent_listening
methods.description: Triggers avatar listening animation.

methods.name: stop_agent_listening
methods.description: Stops avatar listening animation.

methods.name: transport_ready
methods.description: Marks transport as ready to receive frames.

methods.name: agent_speak
methods.description: Sends audio data to avatar for speaking.

methods.name: agent_speak_end
methods.description: Signals end of avatar speech.

methods.name: capture_participant_audio
methods.description: Captures audio frames from a participant.

methods.name: capture_participant_video
methods.description: Captures video frames from a participant.

methods.name: _process_audio_frames
methods.description: Processes incoming audio frames from LiveKit.

methods.name: _process_video_frames
methods.description: Processes incoming video frames from LiveKit.

methods.name: _livekit_connect
methods.description: Connects to LiveKit room and sets up participant event handlers.

methods.name: _livekit_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from LiveKit room and cancels tasks.

methods.name: _call_event_callback
methods.description: Queues participant event callbacks.

methods.name: _callback_task_handler
methods.description: Handles queued callback execution.
